zh: 量子搜索：以量子振幅放大思想实现的查找算法。
平均数反演：v3 用来简化证明的解释方式。
N/2 下界：经典算法达到 50% 成功率所需的最少查看数。
O(sqrt(N))：量子算法所需步骤的量级。
常数因子：本文声明与最快量子算法的差距范围。
STOC 1996：论文首次发表的 ACM 理论计算会议。
en: Quantum search: a search algorithm using amplitude amplification.
Inversion about average: the interpretation simplifying the v3 proof.
N/2 floor: lookups a classical method needs for 50% success.
O(sqrt(N)): the order of steps the quantum scheme requires.
Small constant factor: the gap this paper claims to the quantum optimum.
STOC 1996: the ACM theory conference where the paper appeared.
